Use original photographic markings exactly as shown, never add dimension text or technical drawing lines into the photograph. One unchanged assembled product only, no invented parts or construction.
Professional high-resolution e-commerce catalogue photograph, straight-on frontal elevation of the actual assembled product, centered, showing the face that carries its original logo. Preserve the silhouette and dimensions from all four references. Choose a physically coherent front view without adding hidden geometry. Pure white seamless studio background beneath and behind the product, no visible horizon or seams. Soft evenly balanced illumination from a large diffused source upper left at 5500K with gentle camera-right fill. Soft short contact shadow immediately beneath the product. Full assembled product centered, uncropped, with generous margins, occupying 75 percent of a square frame. 85mm perspective, f/11 and focus stacking, sharp focus everywhere on the product, neutral white balance. No props, visible equipment, support stands or added graphics.
Commercial product photography, magazine-grade. Tack-sharp, true-to-life detail, natural material response, photorealistic.
Avoid: AI sheen and plastic-looking surfaces; smeared or invented lettering; melted or doubled geometry; oversharpened edges and HDR halos; flat frontal flash; stock-catalogue staging; watermarks, signatures, and marks belonging to no one in the scene; flat blocks of dead colour. Also avoid: lettering that bends, smears or dissolves; words the reference does not carry; a mark repeated where there is one; type that drifts from the shapes in the reference.
